mapper.insert: INSERT INTO identity.totp_credential (user_id, secret_encrypted, last_used_step, enrolled_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{secretEncrypted}, #{lastUsedStep}, #{enrolledAt})
INSERT INTO identity.recovery_code (id, user_id, code_hash, used_at, issued_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{codeHash}, #{usedAt}, #{issuedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, code_hash, used_at, issued_at FROM identity.recovery_code WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND used_at IS NULL ORDER BY issued_at, id
mapper.update: UPDATE identity.login_failure SET consecutive_failures = CASE WHEN locked_until IS NULL THEN consecutive_failures + 1 ELSE 1 END, locked_until = CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN locked_until IS NULL THEN consecutive_failures + 1 ELSE 1 END) >= #{maxFailures} THEN CAST(#{lockedUntil} AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) ELSE CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) END, updated_at = #{failedAt} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (locked_until IS NULL OR locked_until <= #{failedAt})
